Check: (1) is it the real solution built by the design, not a patch: each design function exists with the stated signature and result shape; no feature, field, error code or message beyond the design (M01-M37 exact); the order of checks in validate; (2) idioms of the stack and of the code around it (no new style, no dead code, no unused exports or imports, comments follow the surrounding density); (3) the was→became decisions: ctx.line returns true/false, ctx.list "нужно ровно K", the shape.js pure move did not change behaviour (the /1 and /2 outputs of the old tests are byte-identical: run the picker tests and confirm only the seven expected tests are red: PK-2a, PK-6e, PK-7c, PE-8d, LG-1c, LG-1c2, QS-1); (4) behaviour for the cases the design leaves to the developer (P2 min >= max, ctx.mode, order of chips, unknown object id level range): are they sensible and recorded; (5) the shared module is pure and browser-safe (no node: modules) and has no texts.js keys, fallback roles null; (6) nothing of the engine, server, tenants.js or the demo files changed; (7) the quality bar items of the block (Q-numbers named in REQ-069) with YOUR own check; (8) decisions 0073 and 0074 untouched; no machine paths or project names in new files or comments; the bans of the old guard tests (QS-1..12, PK-6e, PK-7c, PE-8d, LG-1c) that went red are red for the reasons the was→became table lists and not for another. Findings with severity, file, line, fix. Verdict PASS or FAIL. Change only your handoff. No commits, no git checkout/reset/stash/clean. 16 GB RAM computer: single commands; the picker test files only. In your handoff text never list project names or machine paths (say "the traces list").

result.summary: PASS: no Critical, High or Medium finding; four Low remarks, none blocking. The verdict is derived from my own reading of the whole diff against the tag base/LOOK069-20261026-01 and from my own runs; the expected result in the task was noted and not used (AP-018). Q1 (cause, not symptom): met. No error is swallowed and no check is silenced. The new rules are real checks written into the field tables of validate.js and v3-check.js; the two helper changes of D15 (ctx.line returns true/false, ctx.list writes the exact-count text only when min equals max) are used as the design says. The only caller of the new ctx.line value is the staff name; the exact-count text is produced by the team size only (I read every ctx.list, checkItems and ctx.texts call: no earlier call has min equal to max, and conditions.js calls 1..8). Q2 (agrees with the record): met. Every function of the design exists with the stated signature and result shape (checkLook, checkOfficeObject, checkChips, checkDesks, checkWhatsapp; publicLook, lookOfView, ownLookOfView; OBJECT_IDS, OBJECT_RULES, GLYPHS, FIGURES, SHIRTS, TEAM_SIZE, SHEET, MIN_CONTRAST, NEUTRAL_COLORS, isMarkSign, isColor, contrastRatio, markOf, deskForQuestion, fallbackLook). I ran about 40 hand cases on the built code against the catalogue 6.4 (look presence, mark, texts, team size with an item error, staff names incl. the dot, the url form, 31 signs, spaces only, U+200B, U+2019, colours incl. the four boundary colours of F10 and #e0731f on both sheets, objects, desks, chips, whatsapp, leads, questions that are not a list or have non-object entries): every place, code and text equals the catalogue, no message holds the word null, no new code beyond the ten. The order of the root fields is schema, id, name, look, intro; checkDesks runs after the root fields; chips and desk are checked after min and max in the question. Key order of the questionnaire, a question, an option, an object and leads equals 7.1 (checked by a loadTenants run on a scratch folder with one /3 tenant: the answer in ru, kk and en has look after name, desk, chips, object, whatsapp in leads, no max_per_hour, no max_stored, no unknown field of the file; the view look is frozen; lookOfView equals ownLookOfView for /3; for a /2 tenant lookOfView is the fallback and ownLookOfView is null). Decisions 0084 and 0085 are followed (item 2 staff name, item 3 object on single and multiple only, item 4 sheets, item 7 and 8 the two public calls, item 9 chips range); 0073 and 0074 are untouched (git status of decisions shows only README.md and the new 0085). Q3 (more than ordered): none. The changed files are exactly the design list 3.1 and 3.2; engine.js, server.js, tenants.js, package.json, eslint.config.js, the demo tenants, the demo answers, tools/test and the fixtures are not changed (git diff --stat empty). No test, sample or helper was written. No new export that the design does not name; the exports that nothing calls yet (checkOfficeObject, lookOfView, ownLookOfView, deskForQuestion, markOf, isFormatV3) are named by the design as the entries for REQ-065, 066, 071, 073, 077, 078. docs/requirements.yaml and decisions/README.md show as modified, and decisions/0085 and the design as new: they are ORCH bookkeeping from before the code step, not code. Q4 (quality bar not eroded): met. Search over the 8 changed source files for skip, todo, FIXME, eslint-disable, prettier-ignore and the shell fallthrough found nothing (output attached); the only match in README is the old sentence that says there is no skip and no todo. Lint and format:check are green. The old guard tests were not edited and no ban was weakened. Q5 (idioms): matches the neighbouring code (ES modules, no dependency, pure functions, ctx style, comments in the density of validate.js and limits.js). The shared module has no import, no node: module, no document, no clock, no random, no state; every export is frozen; no key of texts.js and no text of a language; the fallback roles are null. I ran all search words of 13.1, 13.2 and 13.3 (the criterion 6 search, the page-test words, the writing and network words of PK-6e, PK-7a, PK-8c, LG-10d) over the new and changed files: empty. No machine path and no project name in any new or changed file, comment or this text. Own runs: the picker tests (node --test test/picker-*.test.js): 370 tests, 363 pass, 7 fail, 0 skipped; the seven are exactly PK-2a, PK-6e, PK-7c, PE-8d, LG-1c, LG-1c2, QS-1, and I read each failure: PK-6e, PK-7c and PE-8d fail on the file list (the directory has shape.js and v3-check.js that the literal list lacks), QS-1 on the new file tenant-look.js in public/, LG-1c and LG-1c2 and PK-2a because the value sai-picker-tenant/3 that these tests used as the wrong value is now a right one (PK-2a shows look and the three-language lines of the /3 reading of e-field-schema.json). These are exactly the reasons of the was-to-became table 9 (A), not another; the bans (writing words, node: modules, network words, the closed folder) are not what turned red. traces tests: 56 of 56 green. Byte identity of /1 and /2: I ran the check command over all 43 json samples of the demo tenants and of the two fixture folders on the tag copy and on the current tree: output and exit code identical for 42; the one difference is e-field-schema.json (a /3 schema value, expected, A1). I built the questionnaire for 12 tenant-language pairs (demo tenants and the ok- and legacy samples) with the tag code and the current code: identical sha256. The six demo answers through serve were reported by BACKEND-DEV at the F4 values; my in-process comparison covers the same builder. A hostile run through validateTenant: every path of a full /3 tenant replaced by 16 hostile values (numbers, null, lists, empty objects, language objects inside languages, a 100 000-sign string, a nesting of 16, NaN, Infinity) and deleted: 23 443 cases, 0 exceptions, no line with the word null, undefined or NaN. What TEST-DESIGNER should check especially: (1) P2, both ends valid and min not less than max (I3 of step 09): the built behaviour keeps the question own line at max and also checks each chips item against the inverted range, text such as 'Число 7 вне границ от 10 до 5.'; pin it or ask for a skip of the range (one line of validate.js), see issue I1; (2) the chips order rule uses as 'previous' the nearest earlier item that passed the integer and range check, including an item that itself got E_DUP (I5a); (3) an object with an id outside the catalogue: parameters are checked for form with level 1 to 4; no parameter is reported as not allowed (D9); (4) the staff-name class is tested on the untrimmed value, so a tab or a no-break space at an end is E_FIELD M14 while spaces only give E_LIMIT (zero signs after trimming); (5) the desk integer range in validate.js is the literal 1 to 4 while checkDesks uses TEAM_SIZE (F2): a mutant that changes TEAM_SIZE is not visible in the desk range; (6) guard tests of the was-to-became table: A7, B1 and B2 must be made in one change; (7) the README table of page files was re-aligned by prettier, so its diff is larger than one row.

The text is true and short, passes the shape rule and holds no word null, so it is not a crutch; but it is noise on top of a line that already tells the author the real cause. It is the measured sketch behaviour and BACKEND-DEV recorded it (I3 of step 09), and the design leaves it to the developer, so this is a remark, not a finding against the code.

issues.text: P2 (min not less than max, chips) is built as the sketch behaviour and gives one extra E_LIMIT line per chips item with an inverted range (F4). It is allowed by the design and does not block. Decide before the tests step whether TEST-DESIGNER pins it as it is, or the range is skipped when min is not less than max (one condition at validate.js:291-297); either way the tests must say which.

Two small choices the design leaves to the developer are sensible and recorded by BACKEND-DEV (I5 of step 09): the chips 'previous' rule and the form-only check of the parameters of an object with an unknown id (level 1 to 4). I agree with both; the tests step should pin them. No new decision record is needed (they are inside D8 and D9).

No proposal for a new decision record. No state that the data layout allows and the requirement forbids was found (the all-or-none desk rule, the closed catalogues and the chips range are enforced by the check).

Q8, Q10 and Q11 were noticed, not decided: no module state holds a look, the answers are built field by field, the hostile run threw nothing, and the code calls no address. The items belong to SECURITY-REVIEWER.
